claim: Prometheus/Grafana dashboard export ingestion turns SLO burn, error-rate, and latency evidence into first-class runtime signals linked to real Patchline findings. A synthetic-but-valid Prometheus range export and Grafana dashboard are generated from a real baseline (burning metrics on high-severity tables, healthy on the rest), then re-ingested to extract which tables breach SLOs and correlated back to findings so static severity and observed burn can be compared.
